english.title: Employer of transport worker - unfit through drink or drugs
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) you were the employer of **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) who worked on a

(A)_[railway]_
(B)_[tramway]_
(C)_[guided transport system specified by an order made by the Secretary of State]_

(E)_[as a driver]_
(F)_[as a guard]_
(G)_[as a conductor]_
(H)_[as a signalman ]_
(I)_[in a capacity in which **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) could control or affect the movement of a vehicle]_
(J)_[in a maintenance capacity]_
(K)_[as a supervisor of persons working in a maintenance capacity]_
(L)_[as a look-out for persons working in a maintenance capacity]_

while

(M)_[he]_
(N)_[she]_

was unfit to carry out that work through drink or drugs.
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 28(4) and 36(1) of the Transport and Works Act 1992.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
